title: Tono commercial catalog
description: Single versioned source of truth mapping every commercial store product (Stripe web, Apple App Store, Google Play) to the ONE canonical server entitlement. This file records identifiers and env-var NAMES only. It contains no secrets, no live price/product secret IDs (those arrive at runtime via the named environment variables), and it does not itself set or change any charge. Prices below are the already-approved display amounts, recorded for traceability; they are NOT the billing authority — the provider charges from the IDs/price objects referenced here.
invariants: There is exactly ONE canonical paid entitlement ('pro'). Every provider product maps to it; there is no duplicate or per-provider plan.

A store/client purchase never directly grants access. Access is the server's deterministic projection over provider_purchases -> entitlement_grants (Apple/Stripe) or accounts.plan+status (Stripe/coupon). See apps/backend/store.py User.is_pro and _account_has_active_grant.
Approved prices are display/reference only. Do not change without commercial approval; changing them here does not change any charge (the provider price objects are authoritative).
Product identifiers are shared across Apple and Google Play by design (com.tonoit.pro.monthly / com.tonoit.pro.yearly); the canonical entitlement is provider-agnostic.

There is exactly ONE free-trial length ('trial.days'), and it is internally consistent (trial.period_iso8601 resolves to the same number of days). Apple StoreKit intro offers, Stripe Checkout trial_period_days, and Google Play free-trial offers must all equal it; source + tests pin them to this value. The provider consoles are the billing authority — this value is what they are synchronized to, not a substitute for the console configuration.

There is NO free daily tier. Access is unlimited only during an active trial or paid subscription (or a durable founder grant); expired/canceled/non-entitled callers fail closed. 'daily_limit = -1' means unlimited for an entitled caller; a non-entitled caller has no allowance.

pro.server_projection: apps/backend/store.py: User.is_pro — active entitlement_grants row (Apple IAP or Stripe provider projection) OR identified account plan=pro with subscription_status in (active,trialing,past_due) OR unexpired coupon_pro_expires_at.

approved_prices.note: Display/reference only, USD. Not the charge authority.

trial.note: Canonical free-trial length for EVERY provider and every surface. The single source of truth: Apple StoreKit intro offers (apps/ios/App/Tono.storekit + App Store Connect), Stripe Checkout trial_period_days (apps/backend/payments.py), and Google Play base-plan free-trial offers must all equal this. 'days' and 'period_iso8601' must agree (P2W == 14 days); the catalog validator enforces that invariant at load. The provider consoles remain the billing authority — changing this value requires commercial approval AND a synchronized console update (App Store Connect intro offer, Stripe Price trial, Play Console offer); editing it here does not itself change any live trial.

stripe.customer_binding: Stripe Checkout session client_reference_id + subscription metadata (tono_account_id / tono_device_id). Anonymous web checkout is refused; the browser signs in first (POST /v1/auth/web).
stripe.runtime_config_note: Live Stripe Price IDs are supplied at runtime via the named environment variables below — only the VARIABLE NAMES are recorded here, never the values.

app_store.verification: apps/backend/app_store.py — Apple SignedDataVerifier (x5c chain to configured Apple root), product/ownership re-checked server-side; canonical account UUID is the only entitlement principal.

google_play.client_entitlement_note: apps/android/.../billing/BillingContract.kt EntitlementDecision.isPro returns backendIsPro only — a client-side Play purchase never unlocks Pro.
google_play.server_verification: implemented — apps/backend/google_play.py verifies subscription purchase tokens through the Google Play Developer API (androidpublisher purchases.subscriptionsv2.get), validates package/product/base-plan/state/acknowledgement/obfuscatedExternalAccountId, projects the canonical 'pro' entitlement via provider_purchases -> entitlement_grants (provider='google'), and ingests RTDN Pub/Sub push (OIDC-verified) re-querying the Developer API as authority. Verification is unavailable (503) until server credentials are configured, so a Play purchase still fails closed until the operator wires the environment below.
google_play.runtime_config_note: Server credentials and push-auth parameters are supplied ONLY at runtime via the named environment variables; only the VARIABLE NAMES are recorded here, never values. TONO_GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON (Play Developer API service-account key, inline JSON or file path), TONO_GOOGLE_PACKAGE_NAME (defaults to package_name above), TONO_GOOGLE_SUBSCRIPTION_IDS (defaults to the subscription_id list below), TONO_GOOGLE_BASE_PLAN_IDS (see base_plan_env_var), TONO_GOOGLE_PUBSUB_AUDIENCE + TONO_GOOGLE_PUBSUB_SA_EMAIL (RTDN push OIDC verification) or TONO_GOOGLE_PUBSUB_SHARED_TOKEN (documented shared-secret push boundary).
google_play.base_plan_note: Base plans / offers are configured in the Play Console and resolved at runtime via subscriptionOfferDetails; the exact console base-plan ids are NOT invented here. The server requires the allowed base-plan ids through TONO_GOOGLE_BASE_PLAN_IDS (comma-separated) and fails closed — a verified purchase whose base plan is absent from that set never grants Pro. Confirm and configure the ids from the Play Console before Android launch.

products.base_plan_note: Base-plan id confirmed in the Play Console and supplied via TONO_GOOGLE_BASE_PLAN_IDS at runtime; not pinned here.
